notes.title: HeroSquare has a BRAND NEW DEMO!
notes.content:
Hi all!

There's a new demo available starting from right now! 
I feel this demo represents the final game very well, and it features:
[list]
[*] several boss battles 👾
[*] branching path metroidvania gameplay, with action & exploration
[*] secrets to discover, including a hidden item shop ^^
[*] colorful retro visuals and original chiptune soundtrack
[/list]
[previewyoutube=hF6D7ST9jF0;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

I hope you like it!
